title: Rytual Cafe

seo.title: Rytual Cafe Cart UX Case Study | Leandro Alonso
seo.description: A focused Shopify cart redesign for Rytual Cafe, including UX improvements, gifts, upsells and custom Kaching Bundles logic.

cardSummary: A targeted cart redesign that clarified hierarchy, improved the empty-cart state and connected Shopify cart behavior with Kaching Bundles.
visualAlt: Rytual Cafe Shopify cart redesign concept

hero.summary: A focused redesign of an existing Shopify cart. It improved hierarchy, the empty-cart state, gifts, upsells and Kaching Bundles behavior without rebuilding the store.
hero.outcome: A focused intervention at a high-impact point in the buying journey.

snapshot.scope: Cart drawer redesign and offer integration

context: Rytual Cafe did not need a complete storefront rebuild.
The work focused on the cart drawer and the way products, gifts, upsells and bundle offers behaved within that part of the customer journey.
challenge: The cart needed to present its contents and offers with a clearer visual hierarchy, including a more useful empty-cart state.
Bundle behavior also required custom logic between the Shopify cart and Kaching Bundles.
approach: I treated the cart as a focused product surface: first clarifying its states and information hierarchy, then aligning the offer logic and integration behavior.
Keeping the scope centered on the cart allowed the work to improve a specific journey without forcing a full-store rebuild.
solution: Refined cart hierarchy and interaction behavior.
Improved the presentation of offers, gifts and upsells.
Integrated Kaching Bundles with the cart experience.
Implemented custom logic between Shopify cart state and bundle behavior.
uxCro: The revised hierarchy makes products, totals and offers easier to distinguish.
The empty state gives the cart a purposeful experience even before a product is added.
Gifts, upsells and bundle offers are presented as part of one coherent cart journey.
engineering: Custom cart logic connects Shopify cart state with Kaching Bundles so bundle offers behave correctly inside the redesigned drawer.
The implementation stays focused on cart-related behavior rather than replacing unrelated areas of the existing storefront.
results: A clearer cart experience across products, offers, gifts and upsells.
More coherent Kaching Bundles behavior inside the Shopify cart.
A targeted improvement delivered without a complete storefront rebuild.

beforeAfter.before: The original cart drawer and its existing bundle-offer behavior.
beforeAfter.after: A redesigned hierarchy and empty state, with connected gift, upsell and bundle logic.
